author: AyyJake
body:
I just decided to make this cause I'm bored



anyways on http://pottermore.com/ you can go through quizzes to see what house you are in and what patronus you have so just comment if you want what houses you're in and what patronus and wand you get.


Here are mine


My Patronus: St. Bernard Doggo

Hogwarts house: Ravenclaw

Ilvermorny House: Thunderbird

and wand: Beech wood with a Dragon heartsting core 12 3/4 and unbending flexibility
